newsitem.title: POLAND: ECHO PUBLISHER TO SHIFT TO REAL ESTATE.
newsitem.headline: ECHO PUBLISHER TO SHIFT TO REAL ESTATE.

text.p: The Polish publisher Echo SA wants to shift the core of its business to the real estate market to boost the company's earnings, Echo's president said.

Andrzej Majcher told a news conference he hoped the move would increase Echo's net profit to 2.7 million zlotys this year from 0.4 million last year, but added that the firm would not give up its publishing activity.
"We decided to focus on the real estate sector because the Polish market will be very attractive for many years -- we still lack apartments, shops, hotels, offices, " Majcher said.
He said the publishing activity would bring the firm 1.1 to 1.3 million zlotys of net profit in 1996, while the remaining up to 1.6 million would come from real estate developing operations.
Echo earlier said it expected to earn 2.3 million zlotys on 37.8 million sales in the first six months of 1997.
